display_title: A Secret Kiss From the Young Master
description:
"Say, what do you want?"  
"You, I want you. That means that it will be Cha Hee-joo or Jin-han's."  
“……What does it mean to be yours?"  
"Literally. Everything I want."

Heavenly and heavenly, child-only existence,  
So noble and noble young master, Jinhan.  
To him, who has nothing to be desired or lacking in the world  
There is only one 'his' that I want to have.  
Because of the poor and low blood flow  
Cha Hee-joo, the daughter of a car driver who recognized her as a bug.  
I wanted her so badly.  
I wanted to make her his whole life.  
So he ordered her,  
Be his exclusive maid!

Cha Hee-joo, a dedicated maid of the proud young master.  
The young master's secret kiss to her begins!

* It's a pure cartoon based on the popular romance novel [The Young Master's Secret Kiss]. (MTL)
